_comment: Upserts on a scan-scoped table whose ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE does not refresh scan_id.
An entry here is a claim that the conflict cannot fire from a LATER scan, so there is no stale
scan_id to carry forward. That is a claim about how the conflict key is built, which the static
check cannot decide for itself - hence the baseline rather than a rule.
Adding an entry requires the reason. Fixing one requires removing it: the check fails on a
stale entry too, so this file cannot keep claiming a gap that no longer exists.

stale_scan_id_upserts.reason: execution_id hashes repo_id, command and startedAt (checks-run.ts:43). The timestamp makes every execution a new row, so a later scan never rewrites an earlier one. If that id ever becomes content-derived the way candidate ids are, this becomes D-ST2 and the entry must go.
check_id identifies one check run and a new check run gets a new id, so the pair cannot be rewritten by a later scan.
